title: ci(test): check out Test Core and Test UI at depth 1 and fetch only the history they read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XL3LLnsMifPUBTUagK6HWvv)_

domain:devx#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5ocKVSrMoP2SVG2dfL

Refs #22034

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:根 `ci.yml` 里 Test Core 规划(`test-plan`)、Test Core 分片(`test`)、Test UI 分片(`test-ui`)三个 job 不再用 `fetch-depth: 0`,改为深度 1 检出,再加一步只取"当前提交的完整祖先 + main(PR 目标分支不是 main 时再加它)",不取 tag、不取其它分支;`select-shard-packages.sh` 遇到浅克隆先自己补历史,补不到就报错退出;正文附全部 job 读 git 历史的清单。
- 为什么改:`fetch-depth: 0` 每次拉约 1.5k 个分支和 1.7 万个 tag,慢的是这批 ref 而不是 main 的深度;11-03 那次平台变慢时 19 个 Test UI 分片还没跑测试就在 30 分钟墙上被取消。按 #22034 的裁决,第一个 PR 只动这两条分片车道,读约 100 次运行后再动其它 job。
- 风险与回滚:风险是选包结果变化;已在三类事件(PR、merge queue、push)上用真实提交对比全历史克隆,包集合与规划摘要逐字节一致。新步骤三次拉取都失败会让该 job 变红而不是静默跑全量。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的 `test` job 新步骤 "Fetch this commit's history and the base branch"(注释说明每个读者);`scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh` 新的浅克隆守卫段;正文的 Inventory 表。
- 两分钟验证:打开本 PR 的 CI,看 "Plan Test Core shards" 的新步骤日志打印 `shallow=false, no tags`,以及 "Plan this run's Test Core shards" 的 `Affected-set diff base:` 是本 PR 的 merge base。
- 需要你做的:合并本 PR(受管 `.github/workflows/**`,Tier H,须维护者手合)。

## What changes

Three jobs in the root `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and nothing else in any workflow:

1. **`test-plan` ("Plan Test Core shards"), `test` ("Test Core (N/8)") and `test-ui` ("Test UI (N/16)") check out at depth 1.** Their `fetch-depth: 0` lines (L653, L882, L3825 on `main` `405a78eae`) are gone; `actions/checkout@v7` is left at its default.
2. **One new step in each, right after the checkout, byte-identical in all three: "Fetch this commit's history and the base branch".** It runs `git fetch --no-tags --unshallow origin HEAD_SHA +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main`, adding `+refs/heads/BASE:refs/remotes/origin/BASE` when a pull request targets a branch other than `main`. That is HEAD's whole ancestry (the PR's merge base, the queue's `base_sha` and the push's `before` sha are all in it) and the base branch, with no tags and no other heads. Three attempts, then a red step with an `::error::`; it prints the commit count, `shallow=false` and the remote refs it holds. The `test` job's copy carries the comment naming each reader.
3. **`scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh` deepens a shallow checkout itself, or exits 1.** On `pull_request`, `merge_group` and `push`, a shallow checkout is deepened by HEAD's sha before any diff base is chosen; a deepen that fails prints an `::error::` and exits 1 before `turbo` runs. `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch` read no history and are left alone. This is the guard for a caller without the step above, because on a shallow clone this reader does not fail, it answers wrong (Inventory row 1). The three comments that said "`fetch-depth: 0` already makes this resolve" now name the fetch step.
4. **Pins moved:** `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts` asserted `fetch-depth: 0` on the `test-ui` checkout. It now asserts the fetch step sits between the checkout and the select step, deepens a shallow clone, and fetches `main` and the PR's base branch. `select-shard-packages.selftest.sh` gains four cases (below) and its floor moves 32/158 to 36/193.

⛔ Not in this PR, as the order rules: `type-check-ui` (still `fetch-depth: 0`, L3529) and every other job, any `run:` body beyond the fetch, the job graph, any timeout, any other workflow file, `ui/.github/**`.

## Why

Card #22034, step 2, first PR, released to `domain:devx` by the maintainer's 「以上都同意」 (recorded on the card as 6718334937). `fetch-depth: 0` uses the refspec `+refs/heads/*` plus `+refs/tags/*`. The card measured that ref set, not main's depth, as the cost (473 s locally against 29-32 s for main alone; CI p99 553 s). `domain:devx#2`'s pointer 6674639434 measured the 2026-11-03 slowdown at 5.6-6.5x on the full-ref fetch against about 3x on shallow fetches, with 19 `Test UI (N/16)` shards cancelled at their 30-minute wall behind 1063-1799 s checkouts. After this lands the seat reads about 100 runs of these three jobs: the checkout cost is now the "Checkout repository" step plus the new fetch step.

## Inventory: every step in the root `ci.yml` that reads git history

On `main` `405a78eae`. "Shallow today" is what the reader does on a depth-1 clone with nothing else fetched. Found by reading every `run:` step of all 18 jobs, then every script and package build they call (`scripts/**`, `ui/scripts/**`, `packages/*/scripts/**`), then every test file that runs `git` against the real checkout rather than a fixture repo.

| # | Job · step | Reads | Needs | Shallow today | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `test-plan` · Plan this run's Test Core shards; `test` · Compute this shard's package set → `scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh` | PR: `refs/remotes/origin/BASE` (fetched by ref if absent), `merge-base(origin/BASE, HEAD)`, `rev-list --count PINNED..MERGE_BASE` (log line only). Queue: `base_sha` (fetched by sha if absent). Push: `before` sha (same). Then `git diff --name-only BASE HEAD` and `turbo ls --affected` with `TURBO_SCM_BASE`. `schedule`/`workflow_dispatch`: nothing. | HEAD's ancestry down to the base, and the base branch tip | PR: base branch fetched, `merge-base` finds no path through the graft, `::warning::` and the FULL list (selects everything, loudly). Queue and push: base fetched by sha, `git diff` answers, and turbo prints `WARNING unable to detect git range, assuming all files have changed` and selects every package, exit 0, no annotation (measured below: 131 packages). **Silent.** | Fetch step deepens first; the script now deepens a shallow clone itself or exits 1 (`::error::`). |
| 2 | `test` · Build this shard's dependency closure / Build the sliced package's dependency closure; `test-ui` · Build the @objectstack packages objectui consumes → spec's `build` → `gen:schema` (`packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts`) | `merge-base HEAD origin/main` (fetches `origin/main` at `--depth=1` if absent); when that cannot answer, the committed `authorable-surface.base.json` anchor (its rev fetched at `--depth=1`); the release tag it dates tombstones by (fetched at `--depth=1`); trees at those revs. Only when turbo does not replay spec's build from cache. | HEAD's ancestry and `origin/main` for the merge-base path | Takes the committed-anchor path and prints `ℹ️ shallow history — merge-base HEAD origin/main cannot answer here` (a documented, deliberate fallback, already what every depth-1 job runs). | Fetch step keeps the merge-base path these jobs took under `fetch-depth: 0`. |
| 3 | `test-ui` · Select the tests this change affects (inline) → `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` | PR: `merge-base refs/remotes/origin/BASE HEAD` (no fetch). Queue: `base_sha`. Then `git diff --name-only --relative BASE...HEAD` (three-dot) and `git ls-files`. Other events: full suite, no history. | HEAD's ancestry and the base branch | PR: no `origin/BASE`, `::warning::` and the full suite. Queue: base absent, `git diff` exits 128, `::warning::` and the full suite. Loud, selects everything. | Fetch step deepens first. No guard added in the inline step: `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` runs that step against the real checkout, and a shallow guard there would red it in every depth-1 checkout. |
| 4 | `test` · Run this shard's tests; `test-ui` · Run the ui tests | Suites read the working tree (`git grep`, `git ls-files`) or build fixture repositories; `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` stands in for `merge-base`; `check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts` uses `--base-ref HEAD`. None reads the real repository's history, tags or other branches. | nothing | unaffected | none |
| 5 | `type-check-ui` · check:lockfile-integrity (PR only) → `ui/scripts/check-lockfile-integrity.mjs --base-ref origin/BASE` | `git merge-base origin/BASE HEAD`, `git show REV:pnpm-lock.yaml` | HEAD's ancestry and the base branch | Throws "could not find a merge base"; the step is `continue-on-error`, so the alarm reads nothing and the job stays green. **Silent in effect.** | PR 2 (`type-check-ui` keeps `fetch-depth: 0` here). |
| 6 | `type-check-ui` · Verify changed en strings were followed by the nine translations → `ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` | `merge-base HEAD origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF`, then `origin/main`, then `main`; `git show`/`cat-file` at the base | HEAD's ancestry and `origin/main` (and the PR base) | Exits 1 naming the shallow clone. Loud. | PR 2 |
| 7 | `type-check-ui` · Run type-check over the ui packages | `turbo run type-check --filter=...[BASE]`, BASE = the PR's payload `base.sha` or the queue's `base_sha` | HEAD's ancestry down to BASE | Not measured for the `--filter=[...]` form; the same SCM code measured silent-all for `ls --affected` (row 1), so expect every ui package type-checked. | PR 2 |
| 8 | `type-check-ui` · Build the @objectstack packages objectui consumes | spec's build, as row 2 | as row 2 | as row 2 | PR 2 |
| 9 | `filter` · `dorny/paths-filter` v4.0.3 (already depth 1) | PR: the GitHub API's file list. Push: `before` vs `after`. Queue: `base_sha` vs `head_sha`, base fetched at depth 1, two trees diffed. | two trees, no ancestry | Works; built for depth 1. | none |
| 10 | `build-e2e-ui` · check:eager-closure — resolve the base-branch ceiling constants (PR only, already depth 1) | fetches the payload `base.sha` and `origin/BASE` tip at `--depth=1`, `git cat-file -p` the checker at each | two commits, no ancestry | Works; built for depth 1. Failure is `continue-on-error` and the checker exits 2 (loud). | none |
| 11 | Every other job that builds spec (`build-core`, `dogfood`, `dogfood-verify`, `temporal-conformance`, `ui-deps`, `lint-ui`, `build-e2e-ui`, `live-e2e-ui`, `ui-published-artifacts`; all already depth 1) | spec's build, as row 2 | as row 2 | Committed-anchor path, as row 2. | none |
| 12 | `build-e2e-ui` · The committed SDUI manifest is the one this tree generates | `git diff` of the working tree, `rev-parse HEAD` | nothing | unaffected | none |

No step reads tags or another branch outside the ones above. No other script a `ci.yml` step calls reads history: `plan-test-core-shards.mjs`, `partition-test-shards.mjs`, `check-shard-attestation.mjs`, `check-test-completeness.mjs`, `report-test-leftovers.mjs` (`ls-files --others`), `report-test-timings.mjs`, `check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs`, `run-with-stall-guard.mjs`, `assert-turbo-remote-cache.mjs`, `prune-turbo-cache.mjs`, `check-dts-*`, `check-lean-entry-closure.mjs`, `check-sourcemap-no-sources-content.mjs`, `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, and every `pnpm --dir ui run` script in `lint-ui`/`type-check-ui` other than rows 5-6 (grep for `merge-base`, `log`, `rev-list`, `show REV:`, `cat-file`, `fetch` in each).

## Tests

- `bash scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.selftest.sh`: `all 36 cases passed (193 checks)`. New and changed cases:
  - push and merge_group on a shallow clone: the run prints the deepen line, the clone ends `shallow=false`, and `merge-base(C0, HEAD)` answers (it did not before: a by-sha fetch of the base leaves HEAD grafted);
  - pull_request, merge_group and push on a shallow clone whose remote is unreachable: exit 1, the `::error::` line, `turbo` never called, no `turbo-ls.json`, no `::warning::`;
  - schedule on a shallow clone: no deepen, still shallow, the FULL list.
- **Ablation** of the guard on the committed head (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh --anchor 'pull_request | merge_group | push)' --replacement 'pull_request-ABLATED)'`): mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0), selftest `SELFTEST FAILED (36 cases, 193 checks)` with 24 FAIL lines; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` (from `ui/`) on `select-affected-tests.test.ts`, `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`, `test-file-timings.test.ts`, `check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts`, `check-changeset-presence.test.ts`: 128 passed. Before the pin moved, `select-affected-tests.test.ts` failed on exactly that `fetch-depth: 0` assertion.

## Acceptance notes

**The selection does not change: measured on real commits, the new fetch against a full-history clone.**

The control is a clone that ran the exact `fetch-depth: 0` refspec (`+refs/heads/*` and `+refs/tags/*`, 10300 refs). The candidate is a fresh depth-1 fetch of the same sha, as `actions/checkout` makes it, then this PR's fetch step extracted from `ci.yml` and run as written. Each runs the tree's own `select-shard-packages.sh` and `plan-test-core-shards.mjs` with the event's variables:

| Commit | Event | Diff base | Packages | `turbo-ls.json` md5 | Plan digest | Shards |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #31404's merge ref `71a88bc1b5` (8 files, `packages/rest`) | pull_request | `405a78eae` (merge-base) | 63 / 63 | `2e750807a6b6` both | `3c5802f6…` both | 1-8 both |
| same | merge_group, base `405a78eae` | `405a78eae` | 63 / 63 | `2e750807a6b6` both | `3c5802f6…` both | 1-8 both |
| `main` `383c35303` | push, before `405a78eae` | `405a78eae` | 122 / 122 | `aab238703101` both | `d97c92ae…` both | 1-8 both |
| #31329's merge ref `1a6f01112` (`lint.yml` only) | pull_request and merge_group | `604a2b3b9` | 0 / 0 | `be1dac8b3858` both | `f4a1345e…` both | none |

Test UI, same method: `select-affected-tests.mjs` on #31404's merge ref selects `691 of 6653` in both, filter files identical (md5 `062425c4fc43`). On #31329's merge ref it selects `691 of 6651` with diff base `604a2b3b9`, which is what CI's own full-history `Test UI (1/16)` printed on run 42437703944 (job 128600274602).

This PR's own CI run is the second reading: its `Plan Test Core shards` and `Test UI` logs come from the new step, and the os-dev report on #22034 compares them with the same full-history control.

**Without the fetch, Test Core's reader is silent.** On #31329's merge ref checked out at depth 1, a merge_group run of the old script fetched `base_sha` by sha and then `turbo ls --affected` printed `WARNING unable to detect git range, assuming all files have changed: Git error: fatal: no merge base found` and selected all 131 packages, exit 0 (turbo 2.11.10). That is why the script guard exists.

**Fetch cost here.** Local readings on this container, not CI's: the depth-1 fetch took 8-24 s, the new step 63-71 s (index-pack of about 20.6k commits dominates), and the full refspec on top of main 47 s. This container's network is not CI's, so these are no forecast; the ~100-run reading after merge is the measurement.

**Readers left for PR 2,** from the table: rows 5 and 7 are silent on a shallow clone, so PR 2 owes them the same fetch step before `type-check-ui` drops `fetch-depth: 0`. Row 7 also diffs from the PR payload's frozen `base.sha`, which `test`'s comment calls the base this selection must never use (#6195): an over-selection on long-open PRs, never a skip. Noted, not filed.

**Comments not changed:** `test`'s "WHERE THE AFFECTED DIFF STARTS" block keeps its measurement "in a CI-shaped clone: `fetch-depth: 0` populates `refs/remotes/origin/*`" (a dated reading of why turbo's default base is unsafe, still true of the new clone). `type-check-ui`'s comment at L3587 belongs to PR 2.

**Governed surface.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD` exit 3: "GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record … landing tier: H(人合)", `.github/workflows/** ×1`, 252 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate".

## Verification

Gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (70 families for this diff), run on head `65cf47ab`, each exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran`: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

- **67 exit 0**, among them `pnpm check:select-shard-packages` (the selftest above), `pnpm check:stall-guard-budget`, `pnpm check:stall-guard-headroom`, `pnpm check:shard-attestation`, `pnpm check:ci-filter-parity`, `node scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs`, `node scripts/check-step-collectors.mjs`, `node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test`, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` ("2205 cases pass", fast tier) and `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (under `os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT command-exit 0).
- **NOT MEASURED, no full build in this worktree** (Build Core runs them on this PR): `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 ("Run `pnpm build` first"); `pnpm check:dts-closure` exit 1, its whole list is `missing packages/*/dist/index.d.ts` (the worktree built spec with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` only).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exit 1: 166 files pass; 4 fail on unbuilt dists (`Failed to resolve entry for package "@objectstack/formula"`, ui package builds, spec declarations). After building the six consumer packages under the lock, 2 of the 4 pass; the other 2 (`check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts`, `spec-symbol-ledger-plugin-detail-7265.test.ts`) read spec's `.d.ts`, which this worktree did not emit. None of the 4 reads `ci.yml` or a changed file; Test UI runs them on this PR.
- Outside the derivation: `check-governed-merges --branch HEAD` exit 3 (GOVERNED, Tier H) and `dispatch-gates --tier` (no mandate), both above.
- `pnpm lint`: the diff touches no package, so there is no scoped package lint.
- `main` moved 12 commits after the branch point (to `0647dabb0`); none touches a file this PR changes, so no merge was taken.

`skip-changeset`: `.github/**`, `scripts/ci/**` and `ui/scripts/__tests__/**` ship in no package.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (one step name, one shell variable)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no package touched)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the lane's required Chinese summary)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
